Asociația Fotbal Club Botoșani, commonly known as FC Botoșani, is a Romanian professional football club based in Botoșani. Founded in 2001, the club rose through the divisions before earning promotion... to Liga I in 2013, becoming the first team from the county to reach the top flight. The team plays at the Botoșani Municipal Stadium and is recognized for its white, blue, and red colors. Since joining Liga I, FC Botoșani has established itself as a competitive presence, regularly challenging stronger opponents and maintaining a consistent role in Romanian football.
